name: Kamishiro Miyu
source:
President of the school's student council and head of the swimming club.She excels in both the literary and military arts.

She is blessed with exceptional good looks, making her the object of admiration of all the students at the school.

She is the daughter of a wealthy family, and even her everyday behavior has a refined elegance and grace (she doesn't seem to be aware of this). 

She is not afraid to speak her mind to anyone and behaves with dignity, and has a strong morals that allows her to do what she thinks is right.

Her trademark is her pure white thigh high socks. She is a bit haughty and has a queenly side. She has a very sensitive body and orgasms easily when having sex.
